APCTT-C01.quote: It is a digital model that uses a deterministic mathematical approach based on approximation of physical laws.
APCTT-C01.note: Model basis: physical laws, Green and Ampt infiltration (p14), kinematic wave routing (p16), with citations.

APCTT-C02.quote: This investigation, done in cooperation with the Chester County Water Resources Authority, has two purposes: (1) to determine the feasibility of rainfall-runoff modeling in the Brandywine Creek basin based on available data; and (2) to provide a calibrated model for stormwater management by Chester County.
APCTT-C02.note: Practical application (county stormwater management) and how the model is used (p10).

APCTT-C03.quote: Rainfall-runoff modeling with available data is feasible if a recording rain gage is located in the basin or subbasin being modeled.
APCTT-C03.note: Simulation results demonstrate the model's key function (reproducing storm runoff) and its feasibility.

APCTT-C05.quote: The Modena subbasin was calibrated and verified.
APCTT-C05.note: Calibration and verification against observed storms in the subbasins themselves; errors reported (38 percent calibration, 24 percent verification for Modena peak discharge). Honeybrook could not be calibrated; Coatesville calibrated but not verified.

APCTT-C06.quote: Predictive simulations were made for the Coatesville and Modena sub-basins with selected storms.
APCTT-C06.note: The calibrated models were applied in the real basin to evaluate population growth and proposed flood-control structures. Hyphenation in the PDF text reads 'sub-basins'.

APCTT-C07.note: Intended for county use, but no operational use is reported.

APCTT-C10.note: Borderline: p20 says Coatesville errors 'were not acceptable' and recalibrated, but no acceptance criterion is stated.

APCTT-C11.quote: The Coatesville subbasin is described by 38 overland flow segments, 18 channel segments, two reservoir segments, and one input-hydrograph point.
APCTT-C11.note: Model configuration per subbasin and the storm sets (dates, peak ranges) used for calibration and verification.

APCTT-C12.quote: The Modena subbasin was calibrated and verified.
APCTT-C12.note: All evidence concerns the West Branch Brandywine rainfall-runoff model.

notes: Old scanned report with an OCR text layer. Organizer estimate TRL 5 (only one subbasin verified); on the checklist C06 is shown by the predictive simulations, so this labeller's opinion is TRL 6, with low confidence.
